Answered is data, not native permission approval. Pending/canceled/expired gates prevent successful result reporting. No input or model wake occurs. Recover a lost reply with nesvo_get_run_mutation and the original key.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_ask_decision

description: Read up to eight retained questions and answers in a run. A worker sees only its own current attempt. Deadline expiration is persisted when observed; pagination does not approve or acknowledge anything.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_list_decisions

description: Read the exact decision revision, audience and state before answering. Current-attempt authority is enforced by the host. This does not send input or imply native permission approval.

decisionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_get_decision

description: Record a literal answer at the decision's exact revision. Worker self-answer and coordinator answers to owner-only questions are refused. Answer and worker notice commit together; replay the original key after uncertainty. This does not type an approval, validate work or resume native input.

decisionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_answer_decision

description: Withdraw a pending question at its exact revision, retaining a reason. The current worker may withdraw its own question; addressed authority may cancel. Canceled is not approval: report a non-success result and deliberately retry rather than claiming success.

decisionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_cancel_decision

description: Read up to eight durable messages, without ACK or input. Worker defaults to its own current attempt; owner/coordinator defaults to the run coordinator mailbox. Optional attemptId inspects a worker mailbox. Pending messages repeat until explicit ACK. After consumer restart read from zero; cursors paginate, not acknowledge.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_read_inbox

description: Persist one addressed message for a stable key/correlation. Optional attemptId targets a current worker; omission addresses the coordinator. Workers may send only to their own coordinator. Host supplies authenticated sender. Questions are messages, not approval/decision grants. No PTY/LLM execution. Recover uncertainty through nesvo_get_run_mutation with the original key.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_send_message

description: ACK 1–32 exact IDs in the receiving mailbox. Worker defaults to its own attempt; coordinator to its run inbox. Coordinator cannot ACK on behalf of a worker; owner may explicitly override. Retry the same IDs after loss: first ACK identity/time are preserved. ACK is delivery only, never task execution or validation.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

items.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_ack_messages

description: List visible session IDs, groups and lifecycle without acquiring control.
name: nesvo_list_sessions

description: Inspect one visible session and its independent process/agent/turn state.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_get_session

description: Inspect the process session injected into this MCP launch. Never guesses from the UI focus; a context hint cannot bypass host authority.
name: nesvo_get_current_session

description: Read a bounded terminal replay page with UTF-8 byte cursors. Cursors are byte offsets, not domain-event sequences; gap means retained history expired.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_read_session

description: Explain this session's status evidence/readiness and integration health without exposing owner credentials or prompts.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_explain_session

description: Read repository changes on the host for this session's automatic edit context. Read-only; no staging or commit.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_read_diff

description: Owner-only: open a host review of a session's or absolute folder's local changes, or of a GitHub pull request fetched with gh. The fetch into a host review checkout is capped at 120 s and reuses an existing checkout. Exactly one source: sessionId and/or directory, or pullUrl. Replies reviewOpened with a stable reviewId, base, head and diff revision. Never edits, commits, merges or pushes.

base.description: Base ref for the branch scope; defaults to the repository default branch or the pull request base

directory.description: Absolute host folder, or relative to the session folder

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_open_review

description: Owner-only: deliver review feedback for an open reviewId to a ready idle agent session with one receipt. Without a human lease this is a durable send for a stable key (8192 bytes); a client holding control receives a bracketed paste instead. Never takes control; reuse the same key after uncertainty.

key.description: Idempotency key; derived from review, session and text when omitted

reviewId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

text.description: Literal review text; MCP arguments are capped at 24 KiB. No terminal controls.

name: nesvo_deliver_review

description: Owner-only: read the committed nesvo.toml [worktree] table of a repository (HEAD), its normalized setup/run/env_files/timeout_s, digest and approval state. Runs nothing; requires host worktrees:true. Approving or revoking a digest is a human act through the owner CLI (nesvo worktree approve-setup/revoke-setup) and has no agent tool.

directory.description: Absolute host folder inside the Git repository

name: nesvo_describe_worktree_setup

description: Owner-only: start the approved run steps of a session's host-created worktree after a passed setup. Replies worktreeRunStarted with the log path; the result is a journaled worktree.ran event and the registry run state, not task success.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_run_worktree

description: Owner-only: cancel the active setup or run steps of a session's worktree. Terminates the step process tree; a cancelled setup never starts the agent.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_cancel_worktree

description: Owner-only: remove a closed session's host-created worktree and its nesvo/ branch; refuses unsaved work without discard. Unsaved work is dirty, unpushed or conflicted; discard:true deletes it permanently.

discard.description: Explicitly delete unsaved work; never set without the owner's decision

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_archive_worktree

description: Owner-only: list host-created worktrees (newest 128) with session, branch, presence, setup and run states, logs and archive facts.
name: nesvo_list_worktrees

description: Owner-only: read a repository's committed nesvo.toml [[workflow]] templates at HEAD with their digest and approval state. Each template lists its tasks, tool profiles, workspace modes and budgets. Starts nothing; requires host workflowTemplates:true. Approving or revoking a digest is a human act through the owner CLI (nesvo workflow approve-templates/revoke-templates) and has no agent tool.

directory.description: Absolute host folder inside the Git repository

name: nesvo_list_workflow_templates

description: Owner-only: create a run and its tasks from an approved template through the existing run create/plan/budget/activate/executor commands. Unapproved or changed digests are refused. Reuse the same key after uncertainty; a different template under that key is an idempotency conflict. A started run is not task success.

directory.description: Absolute host folder inside the Git repository

name: nesvo_start_workflow_template

description: Read durable metadata events after a domain cursor. Preserve nextCursor; gap is incomplete history, never success. No terminal transcript.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_read_events

description: Create one background process for a stable idempotency key. Reuse the same key/spec after timeout, never invent another key to retry. Created is not agent readiness or task success. Host authorization still applies.

allowedNesvoTools.description: Owner-only exact native permission additions for this explicit harness process, not inherited by children or restored processes. Does not grant host authority or bypass provider deny/ask rules.

childAllowedNesvoTools.description: Owner-only immutable coordinator policy for authenticated supported Claude harness children. Not copied from the coordinator's own native permissions. Never delegates host roles, allows recursive coordinators or applies merely from parent metadata. Other programs/opt-out children receive no additions.

displayProfile.description: Absolute host path to an owner-declared bounded display manifest. Explicit Claude-only opt-in; pins declared executable/argv/presentation for this launch, without guessing or modifying global statusLine. Callback is display evidence only, not fresh account permission.

effort.description: Requires explicit model; provider-specific native reasoning level

harness.description: Launch-local Nesvo MCP/instructions on supported Claude; inherits coordinator setting when omitted

model.description: Explicit launch-local native model alias/ID, not resolved account availability

parentSessionId.description: Lineage only; scoped creation binds the authenticated parent automatically

prompt.description: Literal agent prompt, at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; not a shell command

role.description: Only owner access may grant coordinator at launch; a coordinator cannot create coordinators

name: nesvo_create_session

description: Submit one literal prompt to a ready idle session for a durable key. Never takes control; human drafts, pending input and decision dialogs are refused. Reuse the same key/prompt after uncertainty; delivery is not agent pickup or task success.

prompt.description: Literal prompt, at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Multiline/tab requires observed bracketed paste. No terminal controls.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_send_prompt

description: Passively wait for one send receipt by id or your original key. Exactly one selector. Binds the matching response, never old idle. Settled means response ended, not validated task success. A timeout returns the receipt and never retries input.

id.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_wait_prompt

description: Submit one Ctrl+C with a durable key; never takes human control. Delivery proves only a native write, not that the agent stopped. May discard the agent's current work. Inspect the same receipt after uncertainty.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_interrupt_session

description: Request native stop of this managed process once for a durable key. Destructive: can lose in-memory work. Refuses human control, retains terminal output/session record. stopRequested is not observed process exit or task success.

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_stop_session

description: Freeze a nonempty draft DAG at an expected revision. Does not start any process or send prompts.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_activate_run

description: Bind one existing worker process to a dependency-ready task. Only host-granted children for coordinators. Refuses human control/drafts/pending input. No prompt is sent. Retain the returned attempt identity; one process per attempt.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

sessionId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

taskId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_assign_task

description: Read a task and four retained attempts per page. Owner/coordinator only. Follow nextOffset; reported success remains unvalidated until separately accepted.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

taskId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_get_task_attempts

description: Read this authenticated worker's current task and attempt. Never uses UI focus or environment identity hints. A superseded attempt is refused.
name: nesvo_get_current_task

description: Read current recovery metadata for the authenticated worker or uniquely bound coordinator run. Multiple runs require explicit selection; owner needs runId. Follow returned current-page nextOffset/expectedDigest. Never adopts processes, replays input, ACKs constraints/messages or validates results.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_recover_run_context

description: Report this worker's exact current attempt result. Include files/artifacts/checks/limitations, using empty arrays when none. Claims are not verification or validation. Reuse the original key after uncertainty; stale senders/replacement reports are refused. Result bound 4 KiB UTF-8.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_report_task_result

description: Record owner/coordinator attestation of the current reported result. Success needs a succeeded report and passed validation checks. Without hostChecks the host records evidence without executing checks; hostChecks:true first runs the task's approved nesvo.toml checks in its worktree, records a hostChecks attestation and refuses success when one fails. Accepted results release dependencies; idle never does. Validation bound 2 KiB UTF-8.

attemptId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_validate_task_result

description: Create a durable draft run once for a stable key. No agent or task is started; scoped coordinators are bound by the host.
name: nesvo_create_run

description: List a bounded page of visible workflow summaries. Follow nextOffset; does not expose goal/instruction text.
name: nesvo_list_runs

description: Read a visible run and its draft DAG by stable run ID. Planned/dependency-ready never means executed or successful.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_get_run

description: Read a visible run's bounded 8 KiB digest: its final record once the run settled, otherwise a live working-state snapshot. A run settles when it succeeded, was canceled, stopped or drained. Summarizes tasks, attempts, outcomes, decisions, budget and evidence pointers (journal cursor, worktree branches, checkpoints). Worker claims stay claims; reading never validates, acknowledges or dispatches.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_get_run_digest

description: Atomically replace a draft DAG at an expected revision. Task keys retain IDs. Dependencies are task keys, not names. Cycles/missing edges are refused. Reuse the original key after uncertainty.

runId.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_set_run_plan

description: Recover the historical result of your workflow metadata mutation by its original key. Separate from native process-operation receipts; never starts an agent.
name: nesvo_get_run_mutation

description: Recover a durable operation by its ID or your original idempotency key. Exactly one selector. Never resend with a fresh key after an unknown result.

id.description: Stable host-issued ID for the named field; run/task/attempt/session IDs are distinct, never names or UI focus

name: nesvo_get_operation

description: Owner-only: registration of a disabled external job trigger with a separate secret and exact current job intent. No listener activation, webhook account registration, model call or provider grant. Enable separately after inspection.

secret.description: Separate random secret TEXT, never owner pairing. Request-only, not returned. GitHub HMAC key uses the 64 ASCII bytes, not hex decoding. Never reuse across trigger routes or rotations.

name: nesvo_create_job_trigger

description: Owner-only: exact-revision trigger filter/job-intent reauthorization. Same job and provider only; existing delivery receipts remain immutable and payload never chooses tools or instructions.
name: nesvo_update_job_trigger

description: Owner-only: read one trigger's retained definition, revision and enablement by its ID. No secret, raw body, signature, model input or dispatch. Mutation reads recover original immutable acceptance.
name: nesvo_get_job_trigger

description: Owner-only: list one bounded page of retained trigger definitions, following nextOffset. No secret, raw body, signature, model input or dispatch. Mutation reads recover original immutable acceptance.
name: nesvo_list_job_triggers

description: Owner-only: explicit enable/disable for future external delivery. Does not cancel admitted occurrences or bypass job enablement. Revocation is permanent.
name: nesvo_set_job_trigger_enabled

description: Owner-only: exact-revision credential rotation with a never-used random secret. Retired credentials no longer authenticate, including delivery replay. Does not retry events or reauthorize changed job intent.

secret.description: Separate random secret TEXT, never owner pairing. Request-only, not returned. GitHub HMAC key uses the 64 ASCII bytes, not hex decoding. Never reuse across trigger routes or rotations.

name: nesvo_rotate_job_trigger

description: Owner-only: permanent revocation of this trigger credential. Preserves accepted delivery history; does not stop already admitted workers or cancel occurrences.
name: nesvo_revoke_job_trigger

description: Owner-only: list one bounded page of a trigger's immutable delivery receipts, following nextOffset. No secret, raw body, signature, model input or dispatch.
name: nesvo_get_job_trigger_deliveries

description: Owner-only: read one immutable delivery receipt by trigger ID and the sender's delivery ID. No secret, raw body, signature, model input or dispatch.
name: nesvo_get_job_trigger_delivery

description: Owner-only: recover the original immutable acceptance of a trigger mutation by its idempotency key. No secret, raw body, signature, model input or dispatch.
name: nesvo_get_job_trigger_mutation

description: Owner-only: list a bounded page of saved launch descriptions for sessions that are not running. A record shows spec.resume when an exact provider conversation was observed. Follow nextOffset. Never starts a process.
name: nesvo_list_recovery

description: Owner-only: start one new process from a saved description in its recorded folder, with optional exact resume. Old prompts and worktree creation are never replayed. resume:true asks the provider for the exact recorded conversation; the session stays closed to automated input until the provider confirms that conversation, otherwise it is marked resumeFailed. Gemini and records without a conversation are refused. A claimed record is never restarted twice.
name: nesvo_restore_session

description: Owner-only: forget one saved description. Running processes, conversations and project files are untouched.
name: nesvo_forget_recovery

description: Owner-only: stop one idle agent's provider process once per key while keeping its session ID, conversation, folder, attention and freshness. The session then shows hibernation.state hibernated. Refused with a precise code for human control, drafts, pending input, unsettled attempts, pending decisions, active runs, armed wakes, children, non-idle agents and providers without verified exact resume (Gemini: hibernate_unsupported). Same key replays the original reply. Requires hibernation:true.
name: nesvo_hibernate_session

description: Owner-only: relaunch one hibernated session under its ID through the exact recorded conversation, replying once the provider proves it. Runs once per key. When identity cannot be proven the relaunch is stopped and refused with resume_unverifiable; the session stays hibernated and can still be relaunched fresh with nesvo_restore_session. Sends no prompt. Same key replays the original outcome. Requires hibernation:true.
name: nesvo_resume_session

description: Owner-only: one page of needs-you items across sessions, runs, pending decisions and finished job results, sorted by priority. Each item has a stable id and a revision; follow nextPage. Acknowledged revisions stay hidden; a newer revision of the same item returns. Needs attentionInbox:true.
name: nesvo_list_attention_inbox

description: Owner-only: acknowledge 1–32 inbox items by id and revision. Acknowledgements are durable receipts: repeating one returns the original acknowledgedAt, and reconnecting never shows the same revision again. Acknowledging does not answer a decision or validate a result.
name: nesvo_ack_attention_inbox

description: Owner-only: pending decisions across all runs, oldest first, eight per page with their run and inbox id. No run ID is needed. Needs decisions:true.
name: nesvo_list_pending_decisions

description: Owner-only: answer one pending decision by its ID at its current revision. choice is the literal answer the worker receives; an optional note follows it after a blank line. Answered or canceled decisions are refused with decision_resolved and expired ones with decision_expired, so a retry never answers twice. Not a native permission grant.
name: nesvo_decide

description: Owner-only: list the host's project registry (at most 256 repository roots), pinned first then by last activity. Each entry has its default branch, open session count and session IDs. Requires host projects:true. Reading never launches, pins or changes anything.
name: nesvo_list_projects

description: Owner-only: read one project's usual launch folder, recent folders, default layout name and worktree setup state. The usual folder has the most launches, the layout name is host-wide and the setup state reports whether nesvo.toml is configured, its approved digest and open worktrees. Approving setup stays a human act through the owner CLI.

root.description: Absolute host path of the repository root, as listed

name: nesvo_project_defaults
